record.summary: Synchronized this repository with its current source-built Skill and established the portable baseline. Adopted the owner-reviewed collaboration principle: optional customization summaries, advisory upgrade facts, and caller-controlled force synchronization. Reconciled AGENTS.md, README, the normative CLI contract and installation examples; the original field report retains its historical proposals with a reviewed-disposition note.

Refined the upgrade guide after Gemini review: failed comparisons identify the file and emit no partial diff, while XML payloads retain schema line endings. The implementation also corrects retired-file status and overwrite receipts, preserves readable Guide CDATA and keeps force synchronization caller-controlled. Regression checks passed; independent re-review follows.
